description: This file defines the main application structure for a macOS app using SwiftUI and AppKit. It includes the App entry point, AppDelegate, and related classes to manage the menu bar item, app lifecycle, updates, and user interactions. It also contains code for handling app startup, termination, update checks, and UI components like the status item mouse handler.

classes.name: StatusItemMouseHandlerView
classes.description: A transparent NSView subclass that intercepts mouse events on the status bar icon to handle clicks and hover events without interfering with the menu interaction.

classes.name: AppDelegate
classes.description: NSObject conforming to NSApplicationDelegate, managing application launch, termination, URL opening, and initialization of various app subsystems and state.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching
methods.description: Performs setup after app launch; initializes app state, checks for duplicates, starts background tasks, and auto-opens chat if specified.

methods.name: applicationWillTerminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup routines during app termination, stopping background tasks and resetting app state.

methods.name: application(_:open:)
methods.description: Handles URL opening events for deep links.

methods.name: scheduleFirstRunOnboardingIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules onboarding display if the app version is new or onboarding has not been seen.

methods.name: isDuplicateInstance
methods.description: Detects if another instance of the app is already running.

methods.name: applyStatusItemAppearance
methods.description: Updates the status item's disabled appearance based on paused or sleeping states.

methods.name: applyAttachOnlyOverrideIfNeeded
methods.description: Handles command-line flags related to attach-only mode and disables launch agent if needed.

methods.name: installStatusItemMouseHandler
methods.description: Sets up mouse event handlers for the status bar item, enabling click and hover interactions.

methods.name: toggleWebChatPanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the web chat panel.

methods.name: statusButtonScreenFrame
methods.description: Calculates and returns the screen frame of the status button.
